rules.description: An agent only takes calls in a language listed among their skills.
At least 11 hours between the end of one shift and the start of the agent's next shift (so at most one shift a day).
Full-timers work only 8-hour shifts, part-timers only 4-hour shifts.
A full-timer works at most 5 shifts a week, a part-timer at most 3.
Nobody is scheduled on a day of approved leave.
Whenever a new hire is on the phones, at least one non-new agent is on the same language at the same time.
